title: Hardrock Entry and Deferrals
claims: The application window is on UltraSignup during the first two weeks of October, with exact dates announced in September.
The lottery is held on the first weekend in December.
The entry fee is 450 USD plus applicable UltraSignup processing fees.
Withdrawals before 1 June receive a 50% refund; no refunds are given after 1 June.
A waiting list is maintained after the field is full.
Selected runners may defer for five years for pregnancy or one year for specified parental circumstances.
